info.name: mnjz-chat — mobile endpoints
info.description:
Endpoints added for the mobile app: reports, support tickets, profile, general settings, working hours and basic automation.

## Setup
Open the collection **Variables** tab and set `base_url` and `token`.

Auth is **Bearer Token** at collection level, so every request inherits it — no need to add the header per request.

## Response envelope
Every endpoint returns the same shape:

| key | when | notes |
|---|---|---|
| `statusCode` | always | equals the HTTP status |
| `success` | always | boolean |
| `message` | always | **may be `null` on success** — declare it nullable |
| `data` | success only | **absent from every error response** |
| `errors` | 400 only | keys are field names, values are `string[]` |

## Pagination
Every list returns `data.items` and `data.pagination` (`page`, `per_page`, `total`, `last_page`). `items` is `[]` when empty — never `null`. `per_page` is capped at **100**.

## Roles
| role | what it can do |
|---|---|
| `owner` | everything, and only it can delete ratings |
| `manager` | everything except deleting ratings |
| `agent` | reads automation and settings but cannot write them, sees no reports, and sees only its own tickets |

Read the caller's role once from `GET /profile` (`data.role`) and use it to show or hide screens, instead of calling an endpoint and getting a 403.

**403 is not a bug**: either the role is not allowed, or the plan does not include the feature. Show `message` as-is — it is already translated.

variable.description: Accept-Language — ar or en. Controls the language of messages and of match_criteria / response_type.
rating uuid — from get customer ratings
canned reply uuid — from get canned replies
approved template uuid — from get general settings → auth_templates
support ticket uuid — from get support tickets
organization local time, filled by campaigns/options
first editable member, filled by team/list

item.name: reports
item.description: Owner and manager only. An agent always gets 403.

request.description:
**Who**: owner, manager

**Plan**: requires the `agent_performance` feature, otherwise 403

**Query**: `from` and `to` as `YYYY-MM-DD`, both optional. Without them the range is the **last 30 days**.

`data.metrics.agents[]` holds per agent: `online`, `last_activity_at`, `active_seconds`, `messages_sent`, `tickets_assigned`, `tickets_closed`, `avg_first_response_seconds`, `avg_resolution_seconds`.

`last_activity_at`, `avg_first_response_seconds` and `avg_resolution_seconds` are **nullable** — an agent who did not work in the range returns null.

query.description: matches name, phone or comment, optional

request.description:
**Who**: owner, manager

**Query**: `rating` (1-5), `search`, `page`, `per_page` — all optional

`data.summary` is computed over the **whole filtered set**, not the current page, so the average does not change while paging.

`summary.pending` counts contacts who were asked to rate and have not answered yet — they are **not** in `items`.

Use `can_delete` to show or hide the delete button instead of calling delete and getting a 403.

**Who**: **owner only** — a manager gets 403

**Plan**: requires the `rating_delete` feature, otherwise 403

Returns 404 when the rating does not exist or belongs to another organization.

A manager can read ratings but not delete them — the bad rating may be about them.

**Who**: owner, manager

**Plan**: requires the `activity_log` feature, otherwise 403

**Query**: `user_id`, `group`, `event`, `search`, `from`, `to`, `page`, `per_page` — all optional

`data.members` and `data.groups` are returned so the filters can be built without another call.

Show `data.retention_days` to the user: the log is deleted automatically after that many days, so it does not look incomplete for no reason.

item.name: presence
item.description:
Realtime agent online/offline status. **Online** = a web tab open or the app in the foreground and beating. **Offline** = everything closed or the beat stopped.

Every user beats while the app is in the foreground and announces leaving when it goes to the background. Owners and managers listen on `broadcast.presence_channel` for the `AgentPresenceChanged` event and reconcile with `GET /performance/status`.

Full spec: `MOBILE_NEW_ENDPOINTS.md` → section 1-ب.

request.description:
**Who**: everyone

Call **immediately** when the app opens, returns to the foreground or the network comes back, then every `data.interval` seconds (30) while in the foreground.

`visible` is optional: `false` keeps the user online without counting active time.

The session is identified by the token, so two devices are two separate clients. Without a beat for 90 seconds the user is announced offline.

**Who**: everyone

Call when the app goes to the background or is closed — the OS suspends it there, so it cannot beat. Managers see the user offline within ~5 seconds, unless another device or a web tab is still open.

**Who**: owner, manager — agents get 403

**Plan**: requires the `agent_performance` feature, otherwise 403

Light status only (no metrics). Call when the presence channel subscription succeeds, when the realtime connection comes back, when the app returns to the foreground, and every minute as a fallback.

`data.agents[]`: `user_id`, `online`, `last_activity_at`, `at` (server ms). Ignore a row whose `at` is older than the last event you applied for that user.

item.name: tickets
item.description: A ticket here is the state of a conversation, not a separate entity: every contact has one 'latest' ticket carrying its status and assignee.

query.description: matches contact name or phone, optional

request.description:
**Who**: everyone — but an **agent sees only its own tickets**, enforced server side with no query needed

**Query**: `status` (`open`/`closed`), `assigned_to`, `search`, `page`, `per_page` — all optional

`assigned_to` takes a user id or the literal **`unassigned`**.

`assigned_to_name` is ready to display without another call. `assigned_seen` tells whether the assignee has opened it yet.

Nullable fields: `assigned_to`, `assigned_to_name`, `contact_name`, `last_message_at`.

**Who**: everyone

Returns `open`, `closed` and `unassigned` counters. For an agent they are scoped to its own tickets.

item.name: support tickets
item.description: Tickets you open with OUR support team. Not the same as /tickets, which is the state of customer conversations.

request.description:
**Who**: everyone — you only ever see your own tickets.

The response carries every dropdown list the screen needs: `categories`, `statuses`, `priorities`.

Support actually works in Waz Business, so `waz_tickets` is the list as the team sees it and is the source of truth for status and replies. When `waz_available` is false that system is unreachable right now — show `items` and warn that the status may be stale.

**Who**: the ticket owner — 404 for anyone else's ticket.

Adds `comments`, each with `user.is_me` so you can align the bubble without comparing ids.

Opening a ticket marks its comments as read; no separate call is needed.

**Who**: everyone, agents included.

All three fields are required; `category` is an id from `categories`.

The response carries `synced_with_support`. **The ticket is saved either way** — false only means syncing with the support system is delayed. Never ask the user to resend, it would create a duplicate.

**Who**: the ticket owner — 404 otherwise.

The response returns the ticket with the refreshed `comments`, so no follow-up GET is needed.
**Who**: the ticket owner. Accepts only a value from `statuses` — anything else returns 400.
**Who**: the ticket owner. Accepts only a value from `priorities` — anything else returns 400.

item.name: profile
item.description: Every user reads and edits their own profile. No role or plan requirement.

request.description:
**Who**: everyone

`data.role` is the **organization role** (`owner`/`manager`/`agent`), not the platform role.

Read it once on app start and use it to show or hide screens.

`verification_enabled` / `is_verified` / `verification_available` mirror the "Verifications" tab in the web profile dialog. Hide the option entirely when `verification_available` is false — the Google Authenticator addon is off.

This is the SETTING. `/verification/send` and `/verification/confirm` perform a verification; they are unrelated.

**Who**: everyone

**Required**: `first_name`, `last_name`, `email`

**Optional**: `phone`, `language`

Returns 400 with `errors.email` when the email is already used by another user.

The response returns the profile after the update.

`verification_enabled` is optional and boolean. Leave it out and the stored value is not touched — it lives in a different tab in the web UI. It is ignored when the Google Authenticator addon is off.

**Who**: everyone

**Required**: `old_password`, `password`, `password_confirmation`

**Rules**: the new password is at least 6 characters and must match the confirmation.

The old password is verified first; a wrong one returns 400 with `errors.old_password`.

item.name: settings
item.description: Reading is open to everyone; writing is owner and manager only.

request.description:
**Who**: everyone

Returns the settings plus every dropdown list the screen needs, so no extra call is required: `timezones`, `sounds`, `contact_groups` (options for `campaigns.failed_campaign_group`) and `auth_templates` (APPROVED templates only).

`timezones` and `sounds` are `{value, label}` objects, not plain strings. `notifications.tone` is one of `sounds[].value` — a file path such as `/sounds/message-pop-alert.mp3`.

`auth_template` is the current selection or null. It carries `components` — the template structure as Meta stores it (HEADER / BODY / FOOTER / BUTTONS) — so you can draw the preview from this one call. It is always an array, `[]` when the structure is missing. `parameters` are the saved variables, null when they belong to a different template.

Only the SELECTED template carries `components`; `auth_templates` stays light. You need `GET /list-templates` only to preview a template the user switched to but has not saved yet.

**Who**: owner, manager — an agent gets 403

Every field is optional and updates are partial, inside sections too: sending only `notifications.tone` leaves `volume` untouched.

`auth_template` is the uuid of the template used by `send-auth-template`. It must be one of `auth_templates` from the GET (APPROVED only) — anything else returns 400. Send `null` to clear it.

`auth_template_parameters.template` must equal `auth_template`, otherwise 400: the sender ignores mismatched variables.

Organization name, address and map coordinates are web-only — they sync with the billing platform.

**Who**: everyone

**Plan**: requires the **Working Hours** addon, otherwise 403

`day` runs from 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday), matching PHP `date('w')`.

**Who**: owner, manager — an agent gets 403

**Plan**: requires the **Working Hours** addon, otherwise 403

**Required per slot**: `day` (0-6), `open` and `close` as `HH:MM`

**Rules**:
- more than one slot per day is allowed
- `close` must be **after** `open`, otherwise 400
- at most 64 slots
- sending `"slots": []` clears the whole schedule — this is intentional

`working_hours_outside_message` is optional, max 4096 characters.

**Who**: everyone

The variables a user can insert into a message — the "Select variable" dialog in the web app. Needed by two screens: the out-of-hours message and the canned reply text.

Show `label` as a button, insert `value` at the cursor. Do not substitute anything in the app — the server replaces the tokens when the message is sent.

Half the list is per-organization (custom contact fields), so it cannot be hardcoded in the app.

item.name: automation
item.description: Canned replies: an automatic reply sent when a customer message matches a trigger. Reading is open to everyone; writing is owner and manager only.

request.description:
**Who**: everyone

**Query**: `search`, `page`, `per_page` — all optional

Older replies whose type is image or audio are listed with their type and `response: null` — show them read-only, do not open them for editing.

**Who**: everyone

Returns 404 when it does not exist or belongs to another organization.

**Who**: owner, manager — an agent gets 403

**Required**: all five fields

`match_criteria`: `exact match` or `contains`

`response_type`: **`text` only in this version** — image and audio need a file upload and are not exposed yet.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Invoices",
  "trigger": "invoice",
  "match_criteria": "contains",
  "response_type": "text",
  "response": "You can find your invoice in your account on our website."
}

request.description:
**Who**: owner, manager

**Required**: all five fields — this update is **not partial**, unlike general settings.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Invoices",
  "trigger": "invoice,invoices",
  "match_criteria": "contains",
  "response_type": "text",
  "response": "You can find your invoice in your account on our website."
}

request.description:
**Who**: owner, manager

**Soft delete**: it disappears from the list but the row is kept.

item.name: campaigns
item.description:
الحملات — **لكل الأدوار** زي الويب (owner, manager, agent).

التسلسل: options → template skeleton → create (مجدولة بعد 7 أيام) → list → show → logs → resend-failed → media-history → delete.

**محتاج**: قالب معتمد (APPROVED) وجهة اتصال واحدة على الأقل في المنشأة.

الأمثلة اليدوية (رفع ملف، إرسال فوري) بيتخطّاها الـ runner إلا لو `run_manual_examples = true`.

request.description:
**Who**: everyone

القوالب المعتمدة، والمجموعات بعدد من سيصلهم فعلاً، وحدّ الباقة، والمنطقة الزمنية اللي بيتقري بيها `time`.

exec: // قالب بلا ترويسة وسائط أسهل للتجربة (لا يحتاج ملف).
pm.test('an approved template exists (needed for the next requests)', () => pm.expect(pick).to.be.an('object'));

request.description:
**Who**: everyone

نفس اللي بيبنيه فورم الويب. التطبيق يملا `value` في كل معامل ويبعت `header` و`body` و`footer` و`buttons` زي ما هي في create.

- `selection` في body/header: `static` (نص) أو `dynamic` (قيمة من `dynamic_values` زي `first name`).
- ترويسة الوسائط: `selection` = `upload` (ملف) أو `history` (uuid من media-history) أو `default` (رابط).

**Who**: everyone · subscription must be active · `campaign_limit`

الجسم بيتبني في pre-request script من الطلب اللي قبله. `time` بصيغة `Y-m-d H:i` بتوقيت المنشأة، أو `skip_schedule: true` للإرسال فوراً.

`contacts`: `all` أو uuid مجموعة. أخطاء التحقق: 400 و`errors` (نفس قواعد الويب).

exec: // يبني جسم الحملة من هيكل القالب (GET campaigns/templates/{uuid}) ويجدولها بعد 7 أيام —
// فلا تُرسل أي رسالة فعلاً، والطلب الأخير في الـ folder يحذفها.
const header = p.header || { format: null, parameters: [] };
// رابط مثال Meta — للتجربة فقط؛ في التطبيق ارفع ملفاً (selection=upload) أو اختر من media-history.
header.parameters = [{ type: header.format, selection: 'default', value: example }];

item.name: team
item.description:
إدارة الفريق — **owner و manager بس** (agent → 403).

الدعوة بتتبعت بالإيميل برابط `/invite/{code}` صالح يوم، والمدعوّ يقبلها من المتصفّح. رابط الدعوة **مش** بيرجع في الـ API عمداً.

`email_sent: false` معناه إن SMTP مش مفعّل: الدعوة اتحفظت بس الإيميل موصلش.

حذف واستعادة عضو أمثلة يدوية (بيتخطّاهم الـ runner) لأنهم بيلمسوا بيانات حقيقية.

item.name: referral (invite a friend)
item.description:
ادعُ صديقاً — **للموبايل بس**، ولكل الأدوار.

الصديق بيفتح `link` (`/r/CODE`) → صفحة التسجيل في الويب → لما يسجّل (فورم أو جوجل أو فيسبوك) الإحالة بتتسجل باسمك. الكود بيتحفظ 30 يوم في cookie.

request.description:
**Who**: everyone

`code`، `link`، `share_text` (جاهز للـ share sheet)، `stats.total` و`stats.subscribed` (اللي عندهم باقة مدفوعة سارية).

request.description:
